theHouse.heading: Vertically Integrated. Built on Quality. , Driven by Innovation.
theHouse.intro: Founded in 1977 in Kanpur—The Leather capital and the heart of India's leather Industry of India—Kings International Ltd. combines traditional craftsmanship with cutting-edge, sustainable manufacturing. From finished leather to leather goods including Saddlery, Belts, Bags, Pets' accessories, Hunting accessories & Gym accessories. We deliver precision, durability, and luxury to global brands, and wholesalers across the world.
